title: Warm Uruguayan Beef Tagine
description: A garlicky and crumbly Uruguayan dish featuring egg wash and candy, served in a ceramic tagine, this recipe is low in carbs and perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the beef mixture to a ceramic tagine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg and a splash of water to make the egg wash.
Brush the egg wash over the beef mixture in the tagine.
Sprinkle the chopped candy over the top of the beef mixture.
Cover the tagine with a lid and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the lid and bake for an additional 30 minutes.
